title: 'Story 8.2: Independent Narrative Text & Narrative-Unavailable State'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-07'
status: 'done'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: '6548fec2d856ea7063bb16f7e53d1745784c3eb2'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Configurações' "Sua evolução" chart (spec-8-1) never shows the AI narrative paragraph FR-39 requires alongside it, and has no distinct state for when only that narrative fails.

**Approach:** Add a second, independent fetch (`GET /dashboard/narrative`) with its own `Resource<String>` cubit. Render the resulting text below the chart only in the >30-entries state — the only scenario with a narrative in the prototype — with a dedicated "unavailable, tap to retry" message when just that fetch fails; the chart itself never degrades.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Call `dashboard-narrative-get` with `queryParameters: {'period': 'all'}` — same fixed value as `dashboard-aggregate-get` (spec-8-1 precedent).
- New `DashboardNarrativeCubit extends Cubit<Resource<String>>`, mirroring `DashboardCubit`'s exact shape: `registerLazySingleton`, constructor-subscribes to `PendingEntryWriteTracker.confirmedWrites` (recompute on every entry write, same as the aggregate), `load()` is generation-guarded.
- `AccountSettingsScreen.initState` calls `narrativeCubit.load()` unconditionally, alongside the existing `dashboardCubit.load()` — two independent fetches fired in parallel, neither awaiting the other.
- `DashboardChartSection` renders the narrative section *only* inside its existing `totalCount > 30` branch — confirmed by `prototype-extract.md` (lines 110-113) and the raw prototype's `cenarioDashboard` enum (`Zero registros`/`Uma entrada`/`Mais de 30`): the AI narrative exists only in the >30 scenario; the `0`/`1`-count branches keep their current hardcoded messages untouched, never fetching or showing narrative text.
- Narrative states inside that branch: `ResourceData<String>` → the text, styled with a new `DesignTokens.dashboardNarrativeTextStyle` (Karla 400 · 13/20, read off `cerne-prototype.html`'s dashboard narrative markup — no existing token matches) + `colorTextSecondary`; `ResourceError<String>` → "Não foi possível gerar o balanço agora" in the same style, plus a tappable "tentar novamente" in `colorAccent` that re-calls `narrativeCubit.load()` (verbatim prototype copy/behavior — `cerne-prototype.html`'s `retryNarrative`); `Idle`/`Loading` → render nothing, so the chart never waits on the narrative.
- `DashboardNarrativeDto` mirrors the full contract (`text`, `generatedAt`), same "decode everything, domain narrows" precedent as `DashboardAggregateDto`; `toDomain()` returns only `text` as a plain `String` (one field — no new entity).
- `DashboardRepository`/`DashboardRemoteDataSource`/`DashboardRepositoryImpl` each gain one new method (`getNarrative`) — same files, same thin-pass-through/decode-to-`malformedResponse` shape as `getAggregate`, not a parallel class.
- `AccountSettingsScreen` announces a narrative `ResourceError` via its existing `_announce`, same as the chart's own error announcement (accessibility precedent, spec-8-1 round 2).

**Ask First:** None. **Never:** couple the two `Resource`s into one state object; show narrative text or its error for `0`/`1`-count states; call `dashboard-narrative-get` from anywhere but `DashboardNarrativeCubit.load()`.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| >30 entries, narrative resolves | aggregate `>30`, narrative `Right(text)` | Chart + narrative text below it | N/A |
| >30 entries, narrative fails | aggregate `>30`, narrative `Left(Failure)` | Chart renders normally; "Não foi possível gerar o balanço agora" + "tentar novamente" | Tap re-calls `load()`, no crash |
| 0 or 1 entries | aggregate count `0`/`1` | Narrative fetch result never rendered; existing hardcoded messages unchanged | N/A |
| Narrative fetch pending | `Idle`/`Loading` | No narrative section shown | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/dashboard/domain/repositories/dashboard_repository.dart:10-22` -- add `getNarrative({required period})` beside `getAggregate`
- `lib/features/dashboard/data/datasources/dashboard_remote_data_source.dart:12-33` -- add `getNarrative`, same `.get('dashboard-narrative-get', queryParameters:)` + try/catch-to-`malformedResponse` shape as `getAggregate`
- `lib/features/dashboard/data/repositories/dashboard_repository_impl.dart:13-25` -- add thin pass-through `getNarrative`
- new `lib/features/dashboard/data/models/dashboard_narrative_dto.dart` (+ `.g.dart`) -- `@JsonSerializable()`, fields `text`/`generatedAt`, `toDomain() => text`; mirror `dashboard_aggregate_dto.dart:1-31`'s structure
- `lib/features/dashboard/presentation/cubit/dashboard_cubit.dart:25-68` -- template for new `presentation/cubit/dashboard_narrative_cubit.dart` (`Cubit<Resource<String>>`, same constructor/`load()`/generation-guard/`confirmedWrites` shape)
- `lib/features/dashboard/dashboard_injection.dart:21-45` -- register `DashboardNarrativeCubit` as a second `registerLazySingleton`, same dependencies as `DashboardCubit`
- `lib/features/dashboard/presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section.dart:131-213` (`_populatedCard`) -- thread `BuildContext` in, add a narrative `BlocBuilder<DashboardNarrativeCubit, Resource<String>>` only inside the `totalCount > 30` branch
- `lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart:17-30,45-48,65-76,183-193` -- add `narrativeCubit` constructor param, provide it, call `.load()` in `initState`, add a `BlocListener` announcing its `ResourceError`
- `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart:135-140` -- pass `sl<DashboardNarrativeCubit>()` to `AccountSettingsScreen`
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart:780-807` -- append `dashboardNarrativeTextStyle` (Karla 400 · 13/20) beside the other dashboard tokens
- `test/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen_test.dart:86-139` -- `_FakeDashboardRepository` needs a `getNarrative` override once the interface grows; add a `_buildNarrativeCubit` helper mirroring `_buildDashboardCubit`
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1689-1736` -- `GET /dashboard/narrative` contract (frozen)
- `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md:110,113` + raw `cerne-prototype.html`'s `retryNarrative`/`narrativeFailed` logic -- source of the >30-only scoping and the retry-link behavior

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `dashboard_repository.dart` / `dashboard_remote_data_source.dart` / `dashboard_repository_impl.dart` -- add `getNarrative` -- new backend call, same layering as `getAggregate`
- [x] `dashboard_narrative_dto.dart` (+ `.g.dart`) -- full-contract DTO + `toDomain()` -- DTO convention (RNF09)
- [x] `dashboard_narrative_cubit.dart` -- `Cubit<Resource<String>>`, `load()` + generation guard + `confirmedWrites` subscription -- mirrors `DashboardCubit`
- [x] `dashboard_injection.dart` -- register `DashboardNarrativeCubit` -- DI wiring
- [x] `dashboard_chart_section.dart` -- render narrative text/error/retry inside the `>30` branch only -- I/O matrix
- [x] `account_settings_screen.dart` + `app_router.dart` -- wire the new cubit through, `load()` on open, announce errors -- screen integration
- [x] `design_tokens.dart` -- `dashboardNarrativeTextStyle` -- AGENTS.md token rule
- [x] Tests under `test/features/dashboard/` (datasource/repository/DTO/cubit/widget) covering the I/O matrix + retry tap + `confirmedWrites` recompute
- [x] Update `account_settings_screen_test.dart`'s fake repository + helpers for the widened constructor

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given the aggregate shows `totalCount > 30` and the narrative fetch resolves, when the screen renders, then the narrative text appears below the chart.
- Given the aggregate shows `totalCount > 30` and the narrative fetch fails, when the screen renders, then the chart still renders normally and a distinct "narrativa indisponível" message with a working retry shows — never blank, never the 0/1-entry wording.
- Given `totalCount` is `0` or `1`, when the screen renders, then no narrative text, error, or retry ever appears, regardless of the narrative fetch's own result.

## Spec Change Log

## Design Notes

The >30-only scoping isn't stated verbatim in `epics.md`'s AC text ("Given the chart has rendered with data") but is unambiguous once cross-referenced: `prototype-extract.md:110-113` gives the AI narrative only to "mais de 30 registros," gives "uma entrada" its own non-AI hardcoded line (already shipped verbatim in spec-8-1), and gives "zero entradas" explicitly "no summary paragraph" — and the raw prototype's `cenarioDashboard` enum itself has only three options, with `narrativeFailed` forcibly set to the `'Mais de 30'` scenario. Firing `narrativeCubit.load()` unconditionally (rather than gating the call on the aggregate's count) keeps the two fetches genuinely decoupled per Boundaries, at the cost of one harmless extra backend call for 0/1-count users whose result is simply never rendered.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- expected: `dashboard_narrative_dto.g.dart` generated, no conflicts
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test test/features/dashboard test/features/account` -- expected: all pass

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- Open Configurações against a >30-entry fixture with narrative success, narrative failure (+ retry tap), and 0/1-entry fixtures confirming no narrative UI appears — covered by widget tests in lieu of a device/simulator (AGENTS.md: none exists yet).

283	  /// Boundaries (amended, Spec Change Log): "`bucketCounts` left-padded
284	  /// with leading zero-count entries to length 10 (when shorter) *before*
285	  /// condensing... via 10 contiguous index chunks, summed `count`,
286	  /// remainder in the last chunk". The original, frozen wording degenerated
287	  /// whenever `bucketCounts.length < _targetCondensedBars`: the floor-
288	  /// division chunk size was `0`, so the first 9 chunks each summed an
289	  /// *empty* range (always `0`) and the 10th silently absorbed the entire
290	  /// total — 9 invisible bars + 1 giant one, defeating the chart for any
291	  /// user whose activity concentrates into fewer than 10 distinct backend
292	  /// buckets while still exceeding 30 entries. [_pad] below removes that
293	  /// degeneracy: once [bucketCounts] is at least [_targetCondensedBars]
294	  /// long (real data, or zero-padded), the same "first 9 chunks of
295	  /// `length ~/ 10`, 10th absorbs the remainder" chunking produces a
296	  /// non-degenerate spread — leading zero bars, then the real data at the
297	  /// end, for a short [bucketCounts]. Always exactly [_targetCondensedBars]
298	  /// ints out, regardless of `bucketCounts.length` (I/O matrix: "`>30`
299	  /// entries, any `buckets.length`").
300	  static List<int> _condense(List<int> bucketCounts) {
301	    final padded = _pad(bucketCounts);
302	    final chunkSize = padded.length ~/ _targetCondensedBars;
303	    final condensed = <int>[];
304	    var index = 0;
305	    for (var i = 0; i < _targetCondensedBars - 1; i++) {
306	      final end = index + chunkSize;
307	      condensed.add(_sum(padded, index, end));
308	      index = end;
309	    }
310	    condensed.add(_sum(padded, index, padded.length));
311	    return condensed;
312	  }
313	
314	  /// Left-pads [bucketCounts] with leading zero-count entries up to
315	  /// [_targetCondensedBars] — a no-op once [bucketCounts] already has at
316	  /// least that many entries (Boundaries: "when shorter").
317	  static List<int> _pad(List<int> bucketCounts) {
318	    if (bucketCounts.length >= _targetCondensedBars) {
319	      return bucketCounts;
320	    }
321	    return [
322	      ...List<int>.filled(_targetCondensedBars - bucketCounts.length, 0),
323	      ...bucketCounts,
324	    ];
325	  }
326	
327	  static int _sum(List<int> list, int start, int end) {
328	    var total = 0;
329	    for (var i = start; i < end; i++) {
330	      total += list[i];
331	    }
332	    return total;
333	  }

340	        borderRadius: BorderRadius.all(Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusMd)),
341	        boxShadow: DesignTokens.elevation1,
342	      ),
343	      child: child,
344	    );
345	  }

367	            topRight: Radius.circular(DesignTokens.dashboardBarRadius),

type: 'feature'

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Configurações' "Sua evolução" chart (spec-8-1) never shows the AI narrative paragraph FR-39 requires alongside it, and has no distinct state for when only that narrative fails.

**Approach:** Add a second, independent fetch (`GET /dashboard/narrative`) with its own `Resource<String>` cubit. Render the resulting text below the chart only in the >30-entries state — the only scenario with a narrative in the prototype — with a dedicated "unavailable, tap to retry" message when just that fetch fails; the chart itself never degrades.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Call `dashboard-narrative-get` with `queryParameters: {'period': 'all'}` — same fixed value as `dashboard-aggregate-get` (spec-8-1 precedent).
- New `DashboardNarrativeCubit extends Cubit<Resource<String>>`, mirroring `DashboardCubit`'s exact shape: `registerLazySingleton`, constructor-subscribes to `PendingEntryWriteTracker.confirmedWrites` (recompute on every entry write, same as the aggregate), `load()` is generation-guarded.
- `AccountSettingsScreen.initState` calls `narrativeCubit.load()` unconditionally, alongside the existing `dashboardCubit.load()` — two independent fetches fired in parallel, neither awaiting the other.
- `DashboardChartSection` renders the narrative section *only* inside its existing `totalCount > 30` branch — confirmed by `prototype-extract.md` (lines 110-113) and the raw prototype's `cenarioDashboard` enum (`Zero registros`/`Uma entrada`/`Mais de 30`): the AI narrative exists only in the >30 scenario; the `0`/`1`-count branches keep their current hardcoded messages untouched, never fetching or showing narrative text.
- Narrative states inside that branch: `ResourceData<String>` → the text, styled with a new `DesignTokens.dashboardNarrativeTextStyle` (Karla 400 · 13/20, read off `cerne-prototype.html`'s dashboard narrative markup — no existing token matches) + `colorTextSecondary`; `ResourceError<String>` → "Não foi possível gerar o balanço agora" in the same style, plus a tappable "tentar novamente" in `colorAccent` that re-calls `narrativeCubit.load()` (verbatim prototype copy/behavior — `cerne-prototype.html`'s `retryNarrative`); `Idle`/`Loading` → render nothing, so the chart never waits on the narrative.
- `DashboardNarrativeDto` mirrors the full contract (`text`, `generatedAt`), same "decode everything, domain narrows" precedent as `DashboardAggregateDto`; `toDomain()` returns only `text` as a plain `String` (one field — no new entity).
- `DashboardRepository`/`DashboardRemoteDataSource`/`DashboardRepositoryImpl` each gain one new method (`getNarrative`) — same files, same thin-pass-through/decode-to-`malformedResponse` shape as `getAggregate`, not a parallel class.
- `AccountSettingsScreen` announces a narrative `ResourceError` via its existing `_announce`, same as the chart's own error announcement (accessibility precedent, spec-8-1 round 2).

**Ask First:** None. **Never:** couple the two `Resource`s into one state object; show narrative text or its error for `0`/`1`-count states; call `dashboard-narrative-get` from anywhere but `DashboardNarrativeCubit.load()`.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| >30 entries, narrative resolves | aggregate `>30`, narrative `Right(text)` | Chart + narrative text below it | N/A |
| >30 entries, narrative fails | aggregate `>30`, narrative `Left(Failure)` | Chart renders normally; "Não foi possível gerar o balanço agora" + "tentar novamente" | Tap re-calls `load()`, no crash |
| 0 or 1 entries | aggregate count `0`/`1` | Narrative fetch result never rendered; existing hardcoded messages unchanged | N/A |
| Narrative fetch pending | `Idle`/`Loading` | No narrative section shown | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/dashboard/domain/repositories/dashboard_repository.dart:10-22` -- add `getNarrative({required period})` beside `getAggregate`
- `lib/features/dashboard/data/datasources/dashboard_remote_data_source.dart:12-33` -- add `getNarrative`, same `.get('dashboard-narrative-get', queryParameters:)` + try/catch-to-`malformedResponse` shape as `getAggregate`
- `lib/features/dashboard/data/repositories/dashboard_repository_impl.dart:13-25` -- add thin pass-through `getNarrative`
- new `lib/features/dashboard/data/models/dashboard_narrative_dto.dart` (+ `.g.dart`) -- `@JsonSerializable()`, fields `text`/`generatedAt`, `toDomain() => text`; mirror `dashboard_aggregate_dto.dart:1-31`'s structure
- `lib/features/dashboard/presentation/cubit/dashboard_cubit.dart:25-68` -- template for new `presentation/cubit/dashboard_narrative_cubit.dart` (`Cubit<Resource<String>>`, same constructor/`load()`/generation-guard/`confirmedWrites` shape)
- `lib/features/dashboard/dashboard_injection.dart:21-45` -- register `DashboardNarrativeCubit` as a second `registerLazySingleton`, same dependencies as `DashboardCubit`
- `lib/features/dashboard/presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section.dart:131-213` (`_populatedCard`) -- thread `BuildContext` in, add a narrative `BlocBuilder<DashboardNarrativeCubit, Resource<String>>` only inside the `totalCount > 30` branch
- `lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart:17-30,45-48,65-76,183-193` -- add `narrativeCubit` constructor param, provide it, call `.load()` in `initState`, add a `BlocListener` announcing its `ResourceError`
- `lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart:135-140` -- pass `sl<DashboardNarrativeCubit>()` to `AccountSettingsScreen`
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart:780-807` -- append `dashboardNarrativeTextStyle` (Karla 400 · 13/20) beside the other dashboard tokens
- `test/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen_test.dart:86-139` -- `_FakeDashboardRepository` needs a `getNarrative` override once the interface grows; add a `_buildNarrativeCubit` helper mirroring `_buildDashboardCubit`
- `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml:1689-1736` -- `GET /dashboard/narrative` contract (frozen)
- `docs/input/prototype/prototype-extract.md:110,113` + raw `cerne-prototype.html`'s `retryNarrative`/`narrativeFailed` logic -- source of the >30-only scoping and the retry-link behavior

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `dashboard_repository.dart` / `dashboard_remote_data_source.dart` / `dashboard_repository_impl.dart` -- add `getNarrative` -- new backend call, same layering as `getAggregate`
- [x] `dashboard_narrative_dto.dart` (+ `.g.dart`) -- full-contract DTO + `toDomain()` -- DTO convention (RNF09)
- [x] `dashboard_narrative_cubit.dart` -- `Cubit<Resource<String>>`, `load()` + generation guard + `confirmedWrites` subscription -- mirrors `DashboardCubit`
- [x] `dashboard_injection.dart` -- register `DashboardNarrativeCubit` -- DI wiring
- [x] `dashboard_chart_section.dart` -- render narrative text/error/retry inside the `>30` branch only -- I/O matrix
- [x] `account_settings_screen.dart` + `app_router.dart` -- wire the new cubit through, `load()` on open, announce errors -- screen integration
- [x] `design_tokens.dart` -- `dashboardNarrativeTextStyle` -- AGENTS.md token rule
- [x] Tests under `test/features/dashboard/` (datasource/repository/DTO/cubit/widget) covering the I/O matrix + retry tap + `confirmedWrites` recompute
- [x] Update `account_settings_screen_test.dart`'s fake repository + helpers for the widened constructor

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given the aggregate shows `totalCount > 30` and the narrative fetch resolves, when the screen renders, then the narrative text appears below the chart.
- Given the aggregate shows `totalCount > 30` and the narrative fetch fails, when the screen renders, then the chart still renders normally and a distinct "narrativa indisponível" message with a working retry shows — never blank, never the 0/1-entry wording.
- Given `totalCount` is `0` or `1`, when the screen renders, then no narrative text, error, or retry ever appears, regardless of the narrative fetch's own result.

## Spec Change Log

## Design Notes

The >30-only scoping isn't stated verbatim in `epics.md`'s AC text ("Given the chart has rendered with data") but is unambiguous once cross-referenced: `prototype-extract.md:110-113` gives the AI narrative only to "mais de 30 registros," gives "uma entrada" its own non-AI hardcoded line (already shipped verbatim in spec-8-1), and gives "zero entradas" explicitly "no summary paragraph" — and the raw prototype's `cenarioDashboard` enum itself has only three options, with `narrativeFailed` forcibly set to the `'Mais de 30'` scenario. Firing `narrativeCubit.load()` unconditionally (rather than gating the call on the aggregate's count) keeps the two fetches genuinely decoupled per Boundaries, at the cost of one harmless extra backend call for 0/1-count users whose result is simply never rendered.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter pub run build_runner build --delete-conflicting-outputs` -- expected: `dashboard_narrative_dto.g.dart` generated, no conflicts
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test test/features/dashboard test/features/account` -- expected: all pass

**Manual checks (if no CLI):**
- Open Configurações against a >30-entry fixture with narrative success, narrative failure (+ retry tap), and 0/1-entry fixtures confirming no narrative UI appears — covered by widget tests in lieu of a device/simulator (AGENTS.md: none exists yet).

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../core/resource.dart';
import '../../../entries/domain/entities/entry.dart';
import '../../../entries/domain/services/pending_entry_write_tracker.dart';
import '../../domain/repositories/dashboard_repository.dart';

/// Drives `DashboardChartSection`'s own AI narrative paragraph (spec-8-2) —
/// a second, independent fetch from [DashboardCubit]'s own aggregate fetch
/// (Boundaries/Never: "couple the two `Resource`s into one state object"),
/// mirroring [DashboardCubit]'s exact shape: a DI `registerLazySingleton`,
/// constructor-subscribed to [PendingEntryWriteTracker.confirmedWrites] so
/// it recomputes on every entry write same as the aggregate, and [load] is
/// generation-guarded the same way.
///
/// Deliberately never caches a previous [load] result across calls, same
/// rationale [DashboardCubit] gives — every [load] re-emits
/// [ResourceLoading] first.
class DashboardNarrativeCubit extends Cubit<Resource<String>> {
  DashboardNarrativeCubit(this._repository, this._tracker)
    : super(const ResourceIdle()) {
    _confirmedSubscription = _tracker.confirmedWrites.listen((_) => load());
  }

  final DashboardRepository _repository;
  final PendingEntryWriteTracker _tracker;
  late final StreamSubscription<({String tempId, Entry entry})>
  _confirmedSubscription;

  /// Same generation-guard convention [DashboardCubit]'s own `_generation`
  /// uses — guards against a stale in-flight [load] call's result landing
  /// after a newer one has already superseded it.
  int _generation = 0;

  /// Boundaries: "`queryParameters: {'period': 'all'}` — same fixed value
  /// as `dashboard-aggregate-get`" — [load]'s one and only call to
  /// [DashboardRepository.getNarrative] always passes this.
  Future<void> load() async {
    final generation = ++_generation;
    emit(ResourceLoading());
    final result = await _repository.getNarrative(period: 'all');
    // Mirrors `DashboardCubit.load()`'s own guard: `close()` can race this
    // awaited call, and a newer `load()` (constructor-triggered
    // `confirmedWrites` event, a second screen open, or a retry tap) can
    // have superseded this one while it was in flight.
    if (isClosed || generation != _generation) {
      return;
    }
    result.match(
      (failure) => emit(ResourceError(failure)),
      (text) => emit(ResourceData(text)),
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<void> close() async {
    await _confirmedSubscription.cancel();
    return super.close();
  }
}

/// A plain (non-mocktail) fake — same convention `dashboard_cubit_test.
/// dart`'s own `_FakeDashboardRepository` uses: several tests here need to
/// resolve two calls out of order (the stale-in-flight-call generation
/// guard), which a single static mocktail stub can't express as naturally.
/// [getAggregate] is never called by this cubit (`DashboardNarrativeCubit`
/// only ever calls [getNarrative]) — throws if reached.
class _FakeDashboardRepository implements DashboardRepository {
  final List<Either<Failure, String>> _results = [];
  final List<Completer<Either<Failure, String>>> _completers = [];
  final List<String> calls = [];

  /// When `true`, [getNarrative] returns a `Completer`-backed future the
  /// test resolves explicitly (via [resolve]) rather than immediately
  /// returning a queued result.
  bool gated = false;

  void queue(Either<Failure, String> result) {
    _results.add(result);
  }

  void resolve(int callIndex, Either<Failure, String> result) {
    _completers[callIndex].complete(result);
  }

  @override
  Future<Either<Failure, DashboardAggregate>> getAggregate({
    required String period,
  }) async => throw UnimplementedError('not expected to be called');

  @override
  Future<Either<Failure, String>> getNarrative({required String period}) {
    calls.add(period);
    if (gated) {
      final completer = Completer<Either<Failure, String>>();
      _completers.add(completer);
      return completer.future;
    }
    if (_results.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError(
        'no queued getNarrative() result for call #${calls.length}',
      );
    }
    return Future.value(_results.removeAt(0));
  }
}

class _FakePendingEntryWriteTracker implements PendingEntryWriteTracker {
  final _confirmedController =
      StreamController<({String tempId, Entry entry})>.broadcast();

  void emitConfirmed() {
    _confirmedController.add((tempId: 'temp-1', entry: _entry('e1')));
  }

  @override
  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> create({
    required String content,
    required EntrySource source,
    int? mediaDurationSeconds,
  }) async => throw UnimplementedError('not expected to be called');

  @override
  Future<void> retry(String tempId) async =>
      throw UnimplementedError('not expected to be called');

  @override
  Stream<List<PendingEntryWrite>> get pendingWrites => const Stream.empty();

  @override
  Stream<({String tempId, Entry entry})> get confirmedWrites =>
      _confirmedController.stream;

  @override
  Future<void> dispose() => _confirmedController.close();
}

/// Collects every state the cubit emits for the duration of [act] — same
/// helper `dashboard_cubit_test.dart` already documents.
Future<List<Resource<String>>> _emittedDuring(
  DashboardNarrativeCubit cubit,
  FutureOr<void> Function() act,
) async {
  final emitted = <Resource<String>>[];
  final subscription = cubit.stream.listen(emitted.add);

  // Flushes any state the broadcast `StreamController` has already queued
  // for delivery but not yet dispatched to this listener — same rationale
  // `dashboard_cubit_test.dart`'s own `_emittedDuring` gives.
  await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
  await subscription.cancel();
  return emitted;

/// a second, independent fetch from [DashboardCubit]'s own aggregate fetch
/// (Boundaries/Never: "couple the two `Resource`s into one state object"),
/// mirroring [DashboardCubit]'s exact shape: a DI `registerLazySingleton`,
/// constructor-subscribed to [PendingEntryWriteTracker.confirmedWrites] so
/// it recomputes on every entry write same as the aggregate, and [load] is
/// generation-guarded the same way.
///
/// Deliberately never caches a previous [load] result across calls, same
/// rationale [DashboardCubit] gives — every [load] re-emits
/// [ResourceLoading] first.
class DashboardNarrativeCubit extends Cubit<Resource<String>> {
  DashboardNarrativeCubit(this._repository, this._tracker)
    : super(const ResourceIdle()) {
    _confirmedSubscription = _tracker.confirmedWrites.listen((_) => load());
  }

  final DashboardRepository _repository;
  final PendingEntryWriteTracker _tracker;
  late final StreamSubscription<({String tempId, Entry entry})>
  _confirmedSubscription;

  /// Same generation-guard convention [DashboardCubit]'s own `_generation`
  /// uses — guards against a stale in-flight [load] call's result landing
  /// after a newer one has already superseded it.
  int _generation = 0;

  /// as `dashboard-aggregate-get`" — [load]'s one and only call to
  /// [DashboardRepository.getNarrative] always passes this.
  Future<void> load() async {
    final generation = ++_generation;
    emit(ResourceLoading());
    final result = await _repository.getNarrative(period: 'all');
    // Mirrors `DashboardCubit.load()`'s own guard: `close()` can race this
    // awaited call, and a newer `load()` (constructor-triggered
    // `confirmedWrites` event, a second screen open, or a retry tap) can
    // have superseded this one while it was in flight.
    if (isClosed || generation != _generation) {
      return;
    }
    result.match(
      (failure) => emit(ResourceError(failure)),
      (text) => emit(ResourceData(text)),
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<void> close() async {
    await _confirmedSubscription.cancel();
    return super.close();
  }

@JsonSerializable()
class DashboardNarrativeDto {

  final String generatedAt;

  factory DashboardNarrativeDto.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) =>

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../core/resource.dart';
import '../../../entries/domain/entities/entry.dart';
import '../../../entries/domain/services/pending_entry_write_tracker.dart';
import '../../domain/repositories/dashboard_repository.dart';

/// Drives `DashboardChartSection`'s own AI narrative paragraph (spec-8-2) —
/// a second, independent fetch from [DashboardCubit]'s own aggregate fetch
/// (Boundaries/Never: "couple the two `Resource`s into one state object"),
/// mirroring [DashboardCubit]'s exact shape: a DI `registerLazySingleton`,
/// constructor-subscribed to [PendingEntryWriteTracker.confirmedWrites] so
/// it recomputes on every entry write same as the aggregate, and [load] is
/// generation-guarded the same way.
///
/// Deliberately never caches a previous [load] result across calls, same
/// rationale [DashboardCubit] gives — every [load] re-emits
/// [ResourceLoading] first.
class DashboardNarrativeCubit extends Cubit<Resource<String>> {
  DashboardNarrativeCubit(this._repository, this._tracker)
    : super(const ResourceIdle()) {
    _confirmedSubscription = _tracker.confirmedWrites.listen((_) => load());
  }

  final DashboardRepository _repository;
  final PendingEntryWriteTracker _tracker;
  late final StreamSubscription<({String tempId, Entry entry})>
  _confirmedSubscription;

  /// Same generation-guard convention [DashboardCubit]'s own `_generation`
  /// uses — guards against a stale in-flight [load] call's result landing
  /// after a newer one has already superseded it.
  int _generation = 0;

  /// Boundaries: "`queryParameters: {'period': 'all'}` — same fixed value
  /// as `dashboard-aggregate-get`" — [load]'s one and only call to
  /// [DashboardRepository.getNarrative] always passes this.
  Future<void> load() async {
    final generation = ++_generation;
    emit(ResourceLoading());
    final result = await _repository.getNarrative(period: 'all');
    // Mirrors `DashboardCubit.load()`'s own guard: `close()` can race this
    // awaited call, and a newer `load()` (constructor-triggered
    // `confirmedWrites` event, a second screen open, or a retry tap) can
    // have superseded this one while it was in flight.
    if (isClosed || generation != _generation) {
      return;
    }
    result.match(
      (failure) => emit(ResourceError(failure)),
      (text) => emit(ResourceData(text)),
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<void> close() async {
    await _confirmedSubscription.cancel();
    return super.close();
  }
}

import 'package:cerne/features/dashboard/domain/repositories/dashboard_repository.dart';

import 'package:cerne/features/entries/domain/entities/pending_entry_write.dart';
import 'package:cerne/features/entries/domain/services/pending_entry_write_tracker.dart';

Entry _entry(String id) => Entry(
  id: id,
  content: 'content-$id',
  source: EntrySource.manual,
  chatMessageId: null,
  occurredAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z',
  serverRevision: 1,
  createdAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z',
  updatedAt: '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z',
);

/// A plain (non-mocktail) fake — same convention `dashboard_cubit_test.
/// dart`'s own `_FakeDashboardRepository` uses: several tests here need to
/// resolve two calls out of order (the stale-in-flight-call generation
/// guard), which a single static mocktail stub can't express as naturally.
/// [getAggregate] is never called by this cubit (`DashboardNarrativeCubit`
/// only ever calls [getNarrative]) — throws if reached.
class _FakeDashboardRepository implements DashboardRepository {
  final List<Either<Failure, String>> _results = [];
  final List<Completer<Either<Failure, String>>> _completers = [];
  final List<String> calls = [];

  /// When `true`, [getNarrative] returns a `Completer`-backed future the
  /// test resolves explicitly (via [resolve]) rather than immediately
  /// returning a queued result.
  bool gated = false;

  void queue(Either<Failure, String> result) {
    _results.add(result);
  }

  void resolve(int callIndex, Either<Failure, String> result) {
    _completers[callIndex].complete(result);
  }

  @override
  Future<Either<Failure, DashboardAggregate>> getAggregate({
    required String period,
  }) async => throw UnimplementedError('not expected to be called');

  @override
  Future<Either<Failure, String>> getNarrative({required String period}) {
    calls.add(period);
    if (gated) {
      final completer = Completer<Either<Failure, String>>();
      _completers.add(completer);
      return completer.future;
    }
    if (_results.isEmpty) {
      throw StateError(
        'no queued getNarrative() result for call #${calls.length}',
      );
    }
    return Future.value(_results.removeAt(0));
  }
}

/// A plain (non-mocktail) fake [PendingEntryWriteTracker] — [emitConfirmed]
/// lets a test drive the Boundaries' own "recomputing on each event"
/// requirement directly, without any capture cubit actually in play.
class _FakePendingEntryWriteTracker implements PendingEntryWriteTracker {
  final _confirmedController =
      StreamController<({String tempId, Entry entry})>.broadcast();

  void emitConfirmed() {
    _confirmedController.add((tempId: 'temp-1', entry: _entry('e1')));
  }

  @override
  Future<Either<Failure, Entry>> create({
    required String content,
    required EntrySource source,
    int? mediaDurationSeconds,
  }) async => throw UnimplementedError('not expected to be called');

  @override
  Future<void> retry(String tempId) async =>
      throw UnimplementedError('not expected to be called');

  @override
  Stream<List<PendingEntryWrite>> get pendingWrites => const Stream.empty();

  @override
  Stream<({String tempId, Entry entry})> get confirmedWrites =>
      _confirmedController.stream;

  @override
  Future<void> dispose() => _confirmedController.close();
}

/// Collects every state the cubit emits for the duration of [act] — same
/// helper `dashboard_cubit_test.dart` already documents.
Future<List<Resource<String>>> _emittedDuring(
  DashboardNarrativeCubit cubit,
  FutureOr<void> Function() act,
) async {
  final emitted = <Resource<String>>[];
  final subscription = cubit.stream.listen(emitted.add);
  await act();
  // Flushes any state the broadcast `StreamController` has already queued
  // for delivery but not yet dispatched to this listener — same rationale
  // `dashboard_cubit_test.dart`'s own `_emittedDuring` gives.
  await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
  await subscription.cancel();
  return emitted;
}

  late _FakeDashboardRepository fakeRepository;
  late _FakePendingEntryWriteTracker fakeTracker;
  late DashboardNarrativeCubit cubit;

    fakeRepository = _FakeDashboardRepository();
    fakeTracker = _FakePendingEntryWriteTracker();
    cubit = DashboardNarrativeCubit(fakeRepository, fakeTracker);
  });

  tearDown(() async {
    if (!cubit.isClosed) {
      await cubit.close();
    }
    await fakeTracker.dispose();
  });

    expect(cubit.state, const ResourceIdle<String>());
  });

  test('load() always passes period: \'all\' (Boundaries: same fixed value '
      'as dashboard-aggregate-get)', () async {
    fakeRepository.queue(right('narrative text'));

    await cubit.load();

    expect(fakeRepository.calls, ['all']);
  });

      'the repository\'s own text', () async {

    final emitted = await _emittedDuring(cubit, cubit.load);

    expect(emitted, [
      isA<ResourceLoading<String>>(),
      isA<ResourceData<String>>().having(
        (s) => s.data,
        'data',
        'Seu balanço do período.',
      ),
    ]);
  });

  test('I/O matrix: "narrative fails" — a Failure from the repository emits '
      'ResourceError, never a crash', () async {
    fakeRepository.queue(
      left(const Failure.networkOffline(message: 'Sem conexão')),
    );

    final emitted = await _emittedDuring(cubit, cubit.load);

    expect(emitted, [
      isA<ResourceLoading<String>>(),
      isA<ResourceError<String>>().having(
        (s) => s.failure,
        'failure',
        isA<NetworkOffline>(),
      ),
    ]);
  });

      'on every entry write, same as the aggregate" — a confirmedWrites '
      'event triggers a brand-new load() with no explicit call from a '
      'screen', () async {

    fakeRepository.queue(right('second'));

      await cubit.load();
      fakeTracker.emitConfirmed();
      await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
    });

    expect(fakeRepository.calls, ['all', 'all']);
    expect(emitted.last, isA<ResourceData<String>>());
    expect((emitted.last as ResourceData<String>).data, 'second');
  });

  test(
    'generation guard: a stale in-flight load() call is discarded once a '
    'newer one (triggered by confirmedWrites) has already superseded it',
    () async {
      fakeRepository.gated = true;

      // First load() starts and never resolves yet.
      // ignore: unawaited_futures
      cubit.load();
      await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
      expect(cubit.state, isA<ResourceLoading<String>>());

      // A confirmedWrites event starts a second, superseding load().
      fakeTracker.emitConfirmed();
      await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
      expect(fakeRepository.calls, ['all', 'all']);

      // The first (stale) call resolving must never land.
      fakeRepository.resolve(0, right('stale'));
      await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
      expect(cubit.state, isA<ResourceLoading<String>>());

      // The second (fresh) call's own result still lands normally.
      fakeRepository.resolve(1, right('fresh'));
      await Future<void>.delayed(Duration.zero);
      expect((cubit.state as ResourceData<String>).data, 'fresh');
    },
  );

  test(
    'a retry tap (AccountSettingsScreen/DashboardChartSection\'s own '
    'narrativeCubit.load() re-call) behaves like any other load() — '
    'ResourceError followed by a fresh ResourceData, no crash',
    () async {
      fakeRepository.queue(
        left(const Failure.networkOffline(message: 'Sem conexão')),
      );
      await cubit.load();
      expect(cubit.state, isA<ResourceError<String>>());

      fakeRepository.queue(right('Recuperado com sucesso.'));
      await cubit.load();

      expect(
        (cubit.state as ResourceData<String>).data,
        'Recuperado com sucesso.',
      );
    },
  );
}

## Intent

**Problem:** Configurações' "Sua evolução" chart (spec-8-1) never shows the AI narrative paragraph FR-39 requires alongside it, and has no distinct state for when only that narrative fails.

**Approach:** Add a second, independent fetch (`GET /dashboard/narrative`) with its own `Resource<String>` cubit. Render the resulting text below the chart only in the >30-entries state — the only scenario with a narrative in the prototype — with a dedicated "unavailable, tap to retry" message when just that fetch fails; the chart itself never degrades.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Call `dashboard-narrative-get` with `queryParameters: {'period': 'all'}` — same fixed value as `dashboard-aggregate-get` (spec-8-1 precedent).
- New `DashboardNarrativeCubit extends Cubit<Resource<String>>`, mirroring `DashboardCubit`'s exact shape: `registerLazySingleton`, constructor-subscribes to `PendingEntryWriteTracker.confirmedWrites` (recompute on every entry write, same as the aggregate), `load()` is generation-guarded.
- `AccountSettingsScreen.initState` calls `narrativeCubit.load()` unconditionally, alongside the existing `dashboardCubit.load()` — two independent fetches fired in parallel, neither awaiting the other.
- `DashboardChartSection` renders the narrative section *only* inside its existing `totalCount > 30` branch — confirmed by `prototype-extract.md` (lines 110-113) and the raw prototype's `cenarioDashboard` enum (`Zero registros`/`Uma entrada`/`Mais de 30`): the AI narrative exists only in the >30 scenario; the `0`/`1`-count branches keep their current hardcoded messages untouched, never fetching or showing narrative text.
- Narrative states inside that branch: `ResourceData<String>` → the text, styled with a new `DesignTokens.dashboardNarrativeTextStyle` (Karla 400 · 13/20, read off `cerne-prototype.html`'s dashboard narrative markup — no existing token matches) + `colorTextSecondary`; `ResourceError<String>` → "Não foi possível gerar o balanço agora" in the same style, plus a tappable "tentar novamente" in `colorAccent` that re-calls `narrativeCubit.load()` (verbatim prototype copy/behavior — `cerne-prototype.html`'s `retryNarrative`); `Idle`/`Loading` → render nothing, so the chart never waits on the narrative.
- `DashboardNarrativeDto` mirrors the full contract (`text`, `generatedAt`), same "decode everything, domain narrows" precedent as `DashboardAggregateDto`; `toDomain()` returns only `text` as a plain `String` (one field — no new entity).
- `DashboardRepository`/`DashboardRemoteDataSource`/`DashboardRepositoryImpl` each gain one new method (`getNarrative`) — same files, same thin-pass-through/decode-to-`malformedResponse` shape as `getAggregate`, not a parallel class.
- `AccountSettingsScreen` announces a narrative `ResourceError` via its existing `_announce`, same as the chart's own error announcement (accessibility precedent, spec-8-1 round 2).

**Ask First:** None. **Never:** couple the two `Resource`s into one state object; show narrative text or its error for `0`/`1`-count states; call `dashboard-narrative-get` from anywhere but `DashboardNarrativeCubit.load()`.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| >30 entries, narrative resolves | aggregate `>30`, narrative `Right(text)` | Chart + narrative text below it | N/A |
| >30 entries, narrative fails | aggregate `>30`, narrative `Left(Failure)` | Chart renders normally; "Não foi possível gerar o balanço agora" + "tentar novamente" | Tap re-calls `load()`, no crash |
| 0 or 1 entries | aggregate count `0`/`1` | Narrative fetch result never rendered; existing hardcoded messages unchanged | N/A |
| Narrative fetch pending | `Idle`/`Loading` | No narrative section shown | N/A |

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../core/resource.dart';
import '../../../entries/domain/entities/entry.dart';
import '../../../entries/domain/services/pending_entry_write_tracker.dart';
import '../../domain/repositories/dashboard_repository.dart';

class DashboardNarrativeCubit extends Cubit<Resource<String>> {
  DashboardNarrativeCubit(this._repository, this._tracker)
    : super(const ResourceIdle()) {
    _confirmedSubscription = _tracker.confirmedWrites.listen((_) => load());
  }

  final DashboardRepository _repository;
  final PendingEntryWriteTracker _tracker;
  late final StreamSubscription<({String tempId, Entry entry})>
  _confirmedSubscription;

  int _generation = 0;

  Future<void> load() async {
    final generation = ++_generation;
    emit(ResourceLoading());
    final result = await _repository.getNarrative(period: 'all');
    if (isClosed || generation != _generation) {
      return;
    }
    result.match(
      (failure) => emit(ResourceError(failure)),
      (text) => emit(ResourceData(text)),
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<void> close() async {
    await _confirmedSubscription.cancel();
    return super.close();
  }
}

## Intent

**Problem:** Configurações' "Sua evolução" chart (spec-8-1) never shows the AI narrative paragraph FR-39 requires alongside it, and has no distinct state for when only that narrative fails.

**Approach:** Add a second, independent fetch (`GET /dashboard/narrative`) with its own `Resource<String>` cubit. Render the resulting text below the chart only in the >30-entries state — the only scenario with a narrative in the prototype — with a dedicated "unavailable, tap to retry" message when just that fetch fails; the chart itself never degrades.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Call `dashboard-narrative-get` with `queryParameters: {'period': 'all'}` — same fixed value as `dashboard-aggregate-get` (spec-8-1 precedent).
- New `DashboardNarrativeCubit extends Cubit<Resource<String>>`, mirroring `DashboardCubit`'s exact shape: `registerLazySingleton`, constructor-subscribes to `PendingEntryWriteTracker.confirmedWrites` (recompute on every entry write, same as the aggregate), `load()` is generation-guarded.
- `AccountSettingsScreen.initState` calls `narrativeCubit.load()` unconditionally, alongside the existing `dashboardCubit.load()` — two independent fetches fired in parallel, neither awaiting the other.
- `DashboardChartSection` renders the narrative section *only* inside its existing `totalCount > 30` branch — confirmed by `prototype-extract.md` (lines 110-113) and the raw prototype's `cenarioDashboard` enum (`Zero registros`/`Uma entrada`/`Mais de 30`): the AI narrative exists only in the >30 scenario; the `0`/`1`-count branches keep their current hardcoded messages untouched, never fetching or showing narrative text.

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../core/resource.dart';
import '../../../entries/domain/entities/entry.dart';
import '../../../entries/domain/services/pending_entry_write_tracker.dart';
import '../../domain/repositories/dashboard_repository.dart';

class DashboardNarrativeCubit extends Cubit<Resource<String>> {
  DashboardNarrativeCubit(this._repository, this._tracker)
    : super(const ResourceIdle()) {
    _confirmedSubscription = _tracker.confirmedWrites.listen((_) => load());
  }

  final DashboardRepository _repository;
  final PendingEntryWriteTracker _tracker;
  late final StreamSubscription<({String tempId, Entry entry})>
  _confirmedSubscription;

  int _generation = 0;

  Future<void> load() async {
    final generation = ++_generation;
    emit(ResourceLoading());
    final result = await _repository.getNarrative(period: 'all');
    if (isClosed || generation != _generation) {
      return;
    }
    result.match(
      (failure) => emit(ResourceError(failure)),
      (text) => emit(ResourceData(text)),
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<void> close() async {
    await _confirmedSubscription.cancel();
    return super.close();
  }
}

## Intent

**Problem:** Configurações' "Sua evolução" chart (spec-8-1) never shows the AI narrative paragraph FR-39 requires alongside it, and has no distinct state for when only that narrative fails.

**Approach:** Add a second, independent fetch (`GET /dashboard/narrative`) with its own `Resource<String>` cubit. Render the resulting text below the chart only in the >30-entries state — the only scenario with a narrative in the prototype — with a dedicated "unavailable, tap to retry" message when just that fetch fails; the chart itself never degrades.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- Call `dashboard-narrative-get` with `queryParameters: {'period': 'all'}` — same fixed value as `dashboard-aggregate-get` (spec-8-1 precedent).
- New `DashboardNarrativeCubit extends Cubit<Resource<String>>`, mirroring `DashboardCubit`'s exact shape: `registerLazySingleton`, constructor-subscribes to `PendingEntryWriteTracker.confirmedWrites` (recompute on every entry write, same as the aggregate), `load()` is generation-guarded.
- `AccountSettingsScreen.initState` calls `narrativeCubit.load()` unconditionally, alongside the existing `dashboardCubit.load()` — two independent fetches fired in parallel, neither awaiting the other.
- `DashboardChartSection` renders the narrative section *only* inside its existing `totalCount > 30` branch — confirmed by `prototype-extract.md` (lines 110-113) and the raw prototype's `cenarioDashboard` enum (`Zero registros`/`Uma entrada`/`Mais de 30`): the AI narrative exists only in the >30 scenario; the `0`/`1`-count branches keep their current hardcoded messages untouched, never fetching or showing narrative text.
- Narrative states inside that branch: `ResourceData<String>` → the text, styled with a new `DesignTokens.dashboardNarrativeTextStyle` (Karla 400 · 13/20, read off `cerne-prototype.html`'s dashboard narrative markup — no existing token matches) + `colorTextSecondary`; `ResourceError<String>` → "Não foi possível gerar o balanço agora" in the same style, plus a tappable "tentar novamente" in `colorAccent` that re-calls `narrativeCubit.load()` (verbatim prototype copy/behavior — `cerne-prototype.html`'s `retryNarrative`); `Idle`/`Loading` → render nothing, so the chart never waits on the narrative.
- `DashboardNarrativeDto` mirrors the full contract (`text`, `generatedAt`), same "decode everything, domain narrows" precedent as `DashboardAggregateDto`; `toDomain()` returns only `text` as a plain `String` (one field — no new entity).
- `DashboardRepository`/`DashboardRemoteDataSource`/`DashboardRepositoryImpl` each gain one new method (`getNarrative`) — same files, same thin-pass-through/decode-to-`malformedResponse` shape as `getAggregate`, not a parallel class.
- `AccountSettingsScreen` announces a narrative `ResourceError` via its existing `_announce`, same as the chart's own error announcement (accessibility precedent, spec-8-1 round 2).

**Ask First:** None. **Never:** couple the two `Resource`s into one state object; show narrative text or its error for `0`/`1`-count states; call `dashboard-narrative-get` from anywhere but `DashboardNarrativeCubit.load()`.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| >30 entries, narrative resolves | aggregate `>30`, narrative `Right(text)` | Chart + narrative text below it | N/A |
| >30 entries, narrative fails | aggregate `>30`, narrative `Left(Failure)` | Chart renders normally; "Não foi possível gerar o balanço agora" + "tentar novamente" | Tap re-calls `load()`, no crash |
| 0 or 1 entries | aggregate count `0`/`1` | Narrative fetch result never rendered; existing hardcoded messages unchanged | N/A |
| Narrative fetch pending | `Idle`/`Loading` | No narrative section shown | N/A |

import 'dart:async';

import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';

import '../../../../core/resource.dart';
import '../../../entries/domain/entities/entry.dart';
import '../../../entries/domain/services/pending_entry_write_tracker.dart';
import '../../domain/repositories/dashboard_repository.dart';

class DashboardNarrativeCubit extends Cubit<Resource<String>> {
  DashboardNarrativeCubit(this._repository, this._tracker)
    : super(const ResourceIdle()) {
    _confirmedSubscription = _tracker.confirmedWrites.listen((_) => load());
  }

  final DashboardRepository _repository;
  final PendingEntryWriteTracker _tracker;
  late final StreamSubscription<({String tempId, Entry entry})>
  _confirmedSubscription;

  int _generation = 0;

  Future<void> load() async {
    final generation = ++_generation;
    emit(ResourceLoading());
    final result = await _repository.getNarrative(period: 'all');
    if (isClosed || generation != _generation) {
      return;
    }
    result.match(
      (failure) => emit(ResourceError(failure)),
      (text) => emit(ResourceData(text)),
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<void> close() async {
    await _confirmedSubscription.cancel();
    return super.close();
  }
}

During the review loop, I found a real defect whose root cause sits inside the spec's frozen intent block (not something I can silently patch around), so per the workflow's protocol this needs your input before I proceed.

**The issue:** The frozen spec says `AccountSettingsScreen` announces a narrative `ResourceError` to VoiceOver unconditionally ("same as the chart's own error announcement"). But the chart's narrative UI only ever *shows* that error when `totalCount > 30` — for 0/1/mid-range counts, the narrative section never renders at all. Since `narrativeCubit.load()` fires unconditionally on every screen open, a user with, say, 5 entries can hear a spoken "narrative failed" announcement for a UI element that was never visible to them — which also technically violates the spec's own adjacent "Never: show narrative text or its error for 0/1-count states" rule (an audio announcement is a form of "showing" the error). 13	## Intent
14	
15	**Problem:** Configurações' "Sua evolução" chart (spec-8-1) never shows the AI narrative paragraph FR-39 requires alongside it, and has no distinct state for when only that narrative fails.
16	
17	**Approach:** Add a second, independent fetch (`GET /dashboard/narrative`) with its own `Resource<String>` cubit. Render the resulting text below the chart only in the >30-entries state — the only scenario with a narrative in the prototype — with a dedicated "unavailable, tap to retry" message when just that fetch fails; the chart itself never degrades.
18	
19	## Boundaries & Constraints
20	
21	**Always:**
22	- Call `dashboard-narrative-get` with `queryParameters: {'period': 'all'}` — same fixed value as `dashboard-aggregate-get` (spec-8-1 precedent).
23	- New `DashboardNarrativeCubit extends Cubit<Resource<String>>`, mirroring `DashboardCubit`'s exact shape: `registerLazySingleton`, constructor-subscribes to `PendingEntryWriteTracker.confirmedWrites` (recompute on every entry write, same as the aggregate), `load()` is generation-guarded.
24	- `AccountSettingsScreen.initState` calls `narrativeCubit.load()` unconditionally, alongside the existing `dashboardCubit.load()` — two independent fetches fired in parallel, neither awaiting the other.
25	- `DashboardChartSection` renders the narrative section *only* inside its existing `totalCount > 30` branch — confirmed by `prototype-extract.md` (lines 110-113) and the raw prototype's `cenarioDashboard` enum (`Zero registros`/`Uma entrada`/`Mais de 30`): the AI narrative exists only in the >30 scenario; the `0`/`1`-count branches keep their current hardcoded messages untouched, never fetching or showing narrative text.
26	- Narrative states inside that branch: `ResourceData<String>` → the text, styled with a new `DesignTokens.dashboardNarrativeTextStyle` (Karla 400 · 13/20, read off `cerne-prototype.html`'s dashboard narrative markup — no existing token matches) + `colorTextSecondary`; `ResourceError<String>` → "Não foi possível gerar o balanço agora" in the same style, plus a tappable "tentar novamente" in `colorAccent` that re-calls `narrativeCubit.load()` (verbatim prototype copy/behavior — `cerne-prototype.html`'s `retryNarrative`); `Idle`/`Loading` → render nothing, so the chart never waits on the narrative.
27	- `DashboardNarrativeDto` mirrors the full contract (`text`, `generatedAt`), same "decode everything, domain narrows" precedent as `DashboardAggregateDto`; `toDomain()` returns only `text` as a plain `String` (one field — no new entity).
28	- `DashboardRepository`/`DashboardRemoteDataSource`/`DashboardRepositoryImpl` each gain one new method (`getNarrative`) — same files, same thin-pass-through/decode-to-`malformedResponse` shape as `getAggregate`, not a parallel class.
29	- `AccountSettingsScreen` announces a narrative `ResourceError` via its existing `_announce`, same as the chart's own error announcement (accessibility precedent, spec-8-1 round 2).
30	
31	**Ask First:** None. **Never:** couple the two `Resource`s into one state object; show narrative text or its error for `0`/`1`-count states; call `dashboard-narrative-get` from anywhere but `DashboardNarrativeCubit.load()`.

39	| 0 or 1 entries | aggregate count `0`/`1` | Narrative fetch result never rendered; existing hardcoded messages unchanged | N/A |
40	| Narrative fetch pending | `Idle`/`Loading` | No narrative section shown | N/A |
41	
42	</frozen-after-approval>

52	- `lib/features/dashboard/presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section.dart:131-213` (`_populatedCard`) -- thread `BuildContext` in, add a narrative `BlocBuilder<DashboardNarrativeCubit, Resource<String>>` only inside the `totalCount > 30` branch

64	- [x] `dashboard_narrative_dto.dart` (+ `.g.dart`) -- full-contract DTO + `toDomain()` -- DTO convention (RNF09)

66	- [x] `dashboard_injection.dart` -- register `DashboardNarrativeCubit` -- DI wiring
67	- [x] `dashboard_chart_section.dart` -- render narrative text/error/retry inside the `>30` branch only -- I/O matrix
68	- [x] `account_settings_screen.dart` + `app_router.dart` -- wire the new cubit through, `load()` on open, announce errors -- screen integration
69	- [x] `design_tokens.dart` -- `dashboardNarrativeTextStyle` -- AGENTS.md token rule
70	- [x] Tests under `test/features/dashboard/` (datasource/repository/DTO/cubit/widget) covering the I/O matrix + retry tap + `confirmedWrites` recompute
71	- [x] Update `account_settings_screen_test.dart`'s fake repository + helpers for the widened constructor
72	
73	**Acceptance Criteria:**
74	- Given the aggregate shows `totalCount > 30` and the narrative fetch resolves, when the screen renders, then the narrative text appears below the chart.
75	- Given the aggregate shows `totalCount > 30` and the narrative fetch fails, when the screen renders, then the chart still renders normally and a distinct "narrativa indisponível" message with a working retry shows — never blank, never the 0/1-entry wording.
76	- Given `totalCount` is `0` or `1`, when the screen renders, then no narrative text, error, or retry ever appears, regardless of the narrative fetch's own result.

## Spec Change Log

- **Finding (blind-hunter + verification-gap review, confirmed):** the original frozen Boundaries line ("announces a narrative `ResourceError` via its existing `_announce`, same as the chart's own error announcement") was unconditional — `narrativeCubit.load()` fires on every screen open regardless of count, so a `0`/`1`/mid-range-count user (for whom `DashboardChartSection` never renders the narrative section at all) could still hear a spoken "narrative failed" announcement for a UI element never shown to them. This also sits in tension with the adjacent frozen `Never: show narrative text or its error for 0/1-count states` line — an audio announcement is a form of showing that error. A second, smaller defect rode along: the announcement used the raw, unsanitized `Failure.message` while the on-screen narrative-unavailable text is fixed copy, so VoiceOver and sighted users received different wording for the same failure.
- **Amendment:** the `_announce` line above now gates on `DashboardCubit`'s own current state (`ResourceData` with `totalCount > 30`) before announcing a narrative error, and announces the same fixed `"Não foi possível gerar o balanço agora"` copy rather than `Failure.message`. This is a read of `DashboardCubit`'s state value from within the narrative listener, not a merge of the two `Resource`s into one state object — the existing `Never: couple the two Resources` line is unaffected.

- Open Configurações against a >30-entry fixture with narrative success, narrative failure (+ retry tap), and 0/1-entry fixtures confirming no narrative UI appears — covered by widget tests in lieu of a device/simulator (AGENTS.md: none exists yet).

## Suggested Review Order

**>30-only scoping & rendering**

- Entry point — the doc comment framing why the narrative only ever renders inside the chart's existing `>30` branch.
  [`dashboard_chart_section.dart:16`](../../lib/features/dashboard/presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section.dart#L16)
- Where the narrative section gets built — only on this one branch, `null` everywhere else.
  [`dashboard_chart_section.dart:167`](../../lib/features/dashboard/presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section.dart#L167)
- `_narrativeSection`'s own three-state switch — Idle/Loading render nothing, Data renders text, Error renders the fixed copy + retry.
  [`dashboard_chart_section.dart:249`](../../lib/features/dashboard/presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section.dart#L249)
- Review-round fix: a blank/empty narrative string now renders nothing rather than an unexplained blank paragraph.
  [`dashboard_chart_section.dart:261`](../../lib/features/dashboard/presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section.dart#L261)
- Review-round fix: the "tentar novamente" retry link now has a real semantic button role, not a bare tap target.
  [`dashboard_chart_section.dart:286`](../../lib/features/dashboard/presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section.dart#L286)
- The fixed narrative-unavailable copy, made non-private so the screen's own announcement (below) can stay in sync with it.
  [`dashboard_chart_section.dart:40`](../../lib/features/dashboard/presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section.dart#L40)

**Accessibility fix: gated, synced VoiceOver announcement**

- Spec Change Log amendment resolved here — announce only when the narrative is actually on screen (`totalCount > 30`), using the same fixed copy as the visual text, never the raw `Failure.message`.
  [`account_settings_screen.dart:231`](../../lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart#L231)
- The two independent fetches firing in parallel on screen open, neither awaiting the other.
  [`account_settings_screen.dart:59`](../../lib/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen.dart#L59)

**Independent fetch lifecycle**

- `DashboardNarrativeCubit` — same `Resource<String>`/generation-guard/`confirmedWrites` shape as `DashboardCubit`, deliberately never coupled into one state object.
  [`dashboard_narrative_cubit.dart:21`](../../lib/features/dashboard/presentation/cubit/dashboard_narrative_cubit.dart#L21)
- `load()`'s own emit/await/generation-check sequence, mirroring the aggregate cubit's own.
  [`dashboard_narrative_cubit.dart:40`](../../lib/features/dashboard/presentation/cubit/dashboard_narrative_cubit.dart#L40)

**Data flow: backend contract to domain**

- The port both `presentation` and `data` depend on — `getNarrative` as a second, independent method beside `getAggregate`.
  [`dashboard_repository.dart:31`](../../lib/features/dashboard/domain/repositories/dashboard_repository.dart#L31)
- The one call site hitting `dashboard-narrative-get` by function name, decoding to `malformedResponse` on a shape mismatch.
  [`dashboard_remote_data_source.dart:38`](../../lib/features/dashboard/data/datasources/dashboard_remote_data_source.dart#L38)
- Thin pass-through, no cache — same shape `getAggregate`'s own impl already uses.
  [`dashboard_repository_impl.dart:28`](../../lib/features/dashboard/data/repositories/dashboard_repository_impl.dart#L28)
- `DashboardNarrativeDto` — mirrors the full contract; `toDomain()` narrows to the one field the UI needs.
  [`dashboard_narrative_dto.dart:10`](../../lib/features/dashboard/data/models/dashboard_narrative_dto.dart#L10)

**Wiring**

- A second `registerLazySingleton` alongside `DashboardCubit`'s own, same dependencies and dispose lifecycle.
  [`dashboard_injection.dart:50`](../../lib/features/dashboard/dashboard_injection.dart#L50)
- Route builder now resolves a third cubit alongside the two `AccountSettingsScreen` already took.
  [`app_router.dart:142`](../../lib/core/navigation/app_router.dart#L142)
- The one new typography token, pixel-sourced from the raw prototype markup since no existing style matched.
  [`design_tokens.dart:819`](../../lib/core/design_tokens.dart#L819)

**Tests**

- `dashboard_chart_section_test.dart` — every >30-only I/O-matrix row, including the retry tap and the 0/1-count never-shows-narrative proof.
  [`dashboard_chart_section_test.dart:410`](../../test/features/dashboard/presentation/widgets/dashboard_chart_section_test.dart#L410)
- `dashboard_narrative_cubit_test.dart` — success/error/generation-guard/`confirmedWrites`-triggered recompute, same template as the aggregate cubit's own suite.
  [`dashboard_narrative_cubit_test.dart:122`](../../test/features/dashboard/presentation/cubit/dashboard_narrative_cubit_test.dart#L122)
- `account_settings_screen_test.dart` — review-round proof that the announcement fires gated and with the fixed copy, and stays silent for 0/1 counts.
  [`account_settings_screen_test.dart:472`](../../test/features/account/presentation/screens/account_settings_screen_test.dart#L472)
- `dashboard_flow_e2e_test.dart` — review-round addition: a real DI/`Dio` round trip against `dashboard-narrative-get`, not just mocked layers.
  [`dashboard_flow_e2e_test.dart:377`](../../test/features/dashboard/dashboard_flow_e2e_test.dart#L377)
- `dashboard_narrative_dto_test.dart` — decode + `toDomain()` narrowing, same convention as the aggregate DTO's own tests.
  [`dashboard_narrative_dto_test.dart:6`](../../test/features/dashboard/data/models/dashboard_narrative_dto_test.dart#L6)
